name: infor-ln-4gl
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, completion, Outline, and Go to Definition for Infor LN / Baan 3GL and 4GL.

scripts.check:grammar: python3 scripts/build-grammar.py && git diff --exit-code -- syntaxes/ln-4gl.tmLanguage.json data/completions.json
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run test:grammar && npm run check:grammar && npm run check:errors && npm run check:catalog && npm run check:catalog-quality && npm run check:audit-catalog-docs && npm run check:predefined

semanticTokenTypes.description: Use of a name introduced by #define in the current file

ln-4gl.includePath.description: Extra directories to search for #include files (absolute or relative to the current file). Useful for LN TEMP dumps: point at the folder that holds shared includes beside the open .bc tabs.

ln-4gl.sessionFolder.description: Optional absolute path to a TEMP (or other) folder whose *.bc / *.cln / *.ln4gl files are indexed for Go to Definition, Find References, and local-function semantic highlighting. Empty = open editor tabs only. Non-recursive; capped at 100 files. Does not scan the whole disk.

ln-4gl.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable block-matching diagnostics (unmatched endif/endselect, …) and idiom warnings.

ln-4gl.diagnostics.strictComments.description: Ignore | line comments when analyzing blocks.

ln-4gl.diagnostics.duplicateCase.description: Warn on duplicate CASE expressions inside ON CASE blocks.

ln-4gl.diagnostics.deprecatedLongIf.description: Warn when a bare identifier is used as an IF condition (deprecated long-as-boolean).

ln-4gl.diagnostics.brackets.description: Report mismatched or unclosed (), {}, [] outside strings and comments.

ln-4gl.diagnostics.continuation.description: Report missing '^' continuation for unclosed strings and multi-line #define bodies.

ln-4gl.diagnostics.dalUiOverlap.description: Show info when a DAL hook and the UI sections it replaces both appear in the same file.

ln-4gl.format.enabled.description: Enable Format Document (indent-only; does not trim trailing whitespace).

ln-4gl.semanticHighlighting.localFunctio.description: Semantic highlighting for calls to functions declared in open ln-4gl tabs (and ln-4gl.sessionFolder when set), e.g. DLL wrappers with dotted names.

ln-4gl.semanticHighlighting.defineUsages.description: Semantic highlighting for uses of names introduced by #define in the current file (e.g. START.EFFECTIVE.DATE).
